label: 001-help
data:
Unone AI-native game developer CLI

Usage: game.exe [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  sdk       
  export    Export one game with the separately compiled release player
  particle  Deterministically sample a native particle definition at a frame
  schema    Inspect/export a structural JSON Schema generated from the runtime Rust types
  project   
  asset     
  api       
  verify    Run every gate a game must pass and report one verdict
  replay    Record a run, or replay a recording to find what changed
  perf      Measure where a frame's time goes
  ui        Draw the game's UI as text and report structural layout problems
  systems   Inspect, search and switch the engine systems this project runs
  platform

label: 001-help
data:
check     
  run       
  test      
  observe   
  preview   
  bundle    
  plugin    Discover and call optional AI-facing plugins
  mcp       Serve the existing Developer Protocol over MCP stdio
  session   Stateful developer protocol: one JSON request and EngineResult per line on stdio
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --sdk <SDK>          Portable SDK root (otherwise environment or executable-relative discovery)
      --project <PROJECT>  [default: .]
      --json               
  -h, --help               Print help
  -V, --version            Print version
